messages.subject: ggplot2
parts:
Hi Guys

I m struggling to install ggplot2 on Ri386 2.15.1,1.15.3,Ri 3.1.2,3.2.0and 3.1.1. But getting the message "package ‘ggplot2’ is not available (for R version 2.15.3)" etc, Could anybody help me in getting the right R and ggplot2 version to run with. Cheers
